summary: New Horizon Aircraft Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering an at-the-market equity offering of up to $50 million of its Class A ordinary shares through sales agent JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC. The ATM program, under a February 14, 2025 sales agreement, allows sales at market prices with a 3.0% sales agent fee. Shares trade on Nasdaq under HOVR; last sale $1.81 on August 27, 2026. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. Monitor for dilution and share-price pressure from ATM sales.
